title: Oh My Glob (LSP) - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: lemons4all, LSP SAO, DEF CON 26 (2018), hackaday.io/project/161510
notes: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.
The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).
D1 = red, tip of the crown spike; D2 = white, behind the star on the forehead. One 1.3k resistor each: red about 1.0-1.2 mA, white about 0.2-0.45 mA.
